newsitem.title: USA: Marker says ruling blocks snowboard exports.
newsitem.headline: Marker says ruling blocks snowboard exports.

text.p: Marker International said Wednesday that a court ruling has been issued that prevents a subsidiary from distributing Sims snowboards outside the United States.
The company said Superior Court of California in the county of Santa Barbara granted a preliminary injunction against Marker's 80 percent owned subsidiary, DNR Sportsystem Ltd.

The ruling blocks DNR from distributing the snowboards pending the outcome of certain arbitration proceedings that have been initiated to determine the enforceability of a license agreement between DNR and Tom Sims.
DNR said it intends to appeal the ruling.
A spokesman for Marker did not immediately return a telephone call.
